Good morning guys on a Saturday !

Went through two concall transcripts, Bluestone Jewellery and Urban Company.

The key highlights from the company's concall transcripts 

BLUESTONE JEWELLERY 

1. New initiatives : Men's and Kid's exclusive jewellery stores.

2. FY27 & FY28 is going to see significant drop in FOCO stores.

3. We are currently in a high growth phase setting up new stores.

4. 20% new store addition on a current base of 340 stores ( COCO + FOCO ) for FY27 and FY28.

5. Minimum 14 cr to 15 cr revenue peer store at peak utilisation.

6. 20% CAGR growth on distribution for several years going forward.

7. SSSG in Q4FY26 of around 34% is not something new , FY20 SSSG was around 30%. Q2 & Q3 of FY25 where good grew the sharpest , in those quarters SSSG's had been the lowest. We perform well when gold is stable.

8. A&P cost to remain at around 6% ( not going overboard on brand building until the distribution is in place )

URBAN COMPANY 

> Highest consol NTV growth in 15 quarters. Crossed 10 million orders in a single quarter for the 1st time.

> 4 points capture where UC stands today.

1. Core is accelerating with structurally improving margins. Growth of 26% in Q4 in India Consumer Services with adj EBIDTA margins expanding to 3.3% from 1.6% a year ago. This business was loss making in FY24.

2. International is scaling rapidly and profitable. UAE and Singapore delivered 84% NTV growth in Q4 to 211 cr. For full year International NTV grew 75% to 700 cr and the business turned adjusted EBIDTA positive. This business is now 4 times the scale it was 4 years ago.

3. Native is on a clear path to profitability. NTV grew 67% in Q4 to 89 cr and 345 cr for the full year - up 122%. EBIDTA loss narrowed from 39 cr in FY25 to 31 cr in FY26. Margins improving from -25.1% to -8.9% of NTV in a single year. 75% of the customers whose devices have hit the first replacement cycle are renewing through UC.

4. Insta help is our most significant investment today and we are leaning in. A business that did not exist at the start of FY26 delivered 2.7 million orders and ₹40 cr of NTV in Q4 with match alone crossing 1.1 million orders. The ₹119 cr adj EBIDTA loss reflects the cost of building a market : Consumer acquisition, network density subsidies and supply onboarding. We are investigating to win and we intent to stay ahead.

> Consol adj EBIDTA break even by Q3FY28 and ₹1,000 cr by FY31.

> India Consumer Services has been accelerating from the last 3 quarters. Wait and watch for the next 3-4 quarters before calling it a long term trend. 

> We don't worry about competition too much. Our eyes are on the customer and the service professional and we are planning to win.

> Penetrating deeper markets in the established micro markets is the current focus rather than adding new markets. Cost to serve has to work out well before adding new markets.

> Not worried about the size of the TAM of Insta help , we want to win and win big. Attack it aggressively and win it.
